name: Apple_ID_Phishing
author: doyun
description: Apple ID 및 계정 보안 경고를 사칭하는 피싱 페이지 탐지

eq: match text "apple" AND match text "apple id" AND match text "account has been locked"
match text "apple id" AND match text "verify your identity" AND match text "password"
match text "apple id" AND match text "security alert" AND match text "sign in"
match text "apple" AND match text "account verification" AND match text "payment information"
